narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Ruled Ledger"**

Rata looks like a broker's statement printed on plain paper. One framed column, 72rem wide, runs from the top bar to the footer, and its 1px side rails never break. Inside the frame, hairline rules do every job other systems hand to cards, shadows, and spacing: they divide columns, carry section headings, and underline each ledger line. The page has no ornament. Grey carries structure, one green carries the path to the answer, and every figure sits in a monospace with tabular digits so columns of rupiah align to the digit.

Density is moderate and work-focused. Controls hold a 44px target, labels sit 8px above their fields, and fields stack 20px apart. The two surface types share the frame: the calculator splits it into ruled working columns, and the reading pages split it into a narrow heading rail and a wide text column. Light and dark follow the system setting and swap palettes without changing structure.
keyCharacteristics: One framed column with continuous 1px side rails, including the header bar and footer.
Square corners on every surface and control.
Flat: depth comes from a sunk grey tint, never a shadow.
Geist for words, Geist Mono with tabular digits for every number.
Green marks the mark, the current location, the action, focus, and the computed total.

rules.name: The Green Path Rule
rules.body: Green marks where you are, what you can press, where focus sits, and the total the order produces. Labels, borders, backgrounds, and the large answer figure stay neutral.

rules.name: The Opacity Ladder Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is ink at 75, 70, 65 or 60 percent, never a separate grey token, so both themes stay correct from one class.

rules.name: The Mono Figure Rule
rules.body: Every number renders in Geist Mono with tabular digits: inputs, ledger values, table cells, fee rates, and figures inside running prose.

rules.name: The 500 Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Headings, labels and inline emphasis top out at weight 500. Use size, tracking, and ink strength for hierarchy. Button labels are the one exception, at daisyUI's 600.

rules.name: The Ruled Frame Rule
rules.body: Divide space with 1px rules that touch the frame, never with gaps, floating cards, or margins between panels.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: No shadows on any surface. A region that must read as recessed takes a paper-sunk tint and a rule border.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Radius is 0 everywhere, including buttons, fields, the arrow node, and focus outlines.

dos: Do set every number in Geist Mono with tabular digits, including figures inside prose.
Do separate regions with 1px rule-colored borders that run to the frame rails.
Do open working columns, tab rows, and breadcrumbs with a 48px ruled band.
Do use the `1fr 2.3fr` heading rail for reading sections from 1024px.
Do express secondary text as ink at 75, 70, 65 or 60 percent opacity.
Do keep controls at 44px minimum height and focus as a 2px green outline offset 3px.
donts: Don't round any corner; radius is 0 in both themes.
Don't add box shadows; recess with a paper-sunk tint instead.
Don't use green for borders, backgrounds, labels, or decoration outside the Green Path Rule.
Don't set figures in proportional Geist or headings and text emphasis above weight 500.
Don't float panels inside the frame with gaps or margins between them.
